nodes.title: H3 Unified Production Guide
widgets_values:
# MiniMax H3 — Unified Production Workflow (RTX 4060 8GB & 16GB+ Ready)

One clean workflow for **T2V, I2V, FL2V, and Ref2V** with **adaptive latent temporal repair, optional 1.5x/2.0x joint latent upscale, pristine native audio, and RTX VSR 2x finish**.

---

## Quick Start (Use the 3 Toggle Panels on the Left)

### 1. Generation Mode (Cyan — pick ONE)
- **FL2VA (T2V / I2V / FL2V)** *(Default ON)*: Uses `MiniMax-H3-FL2VA-pruned_rank8_int8_convrot.safetensors`.
  - All input images **OFF** = **T2V**
  - **Image 1 ON** = **I2V** (first frame)
  - **Image 1 + Image 2 ON** = **FL2V** (first + last frame)
- **REF2VA (Reference to Video)**: Uses `MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-pruned_rank8_int8_convrot.safetensors`.
  - Enable **Image 1–3** and/or **Ref Audio**, and tag `<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`, `<Audio 1>` in the prompt.

### 2. Hardware & Speed Presets (Brown Panel)
| Preset | Toggle Settings |
|---|---|
| **8 GB VRAM Default (RTX 4060)** | `1. Low VRAM 8GB` **ON**, `2. Pass-1 FirstBlockCache` **ON**, `4. Pass-2 Sol-Attn INT8` **ON**, `5. Pass-2 Repair` **ON**, `3. Turbo LoRA` **OFF** |
| **16–24 GB+ VRAM** | Turn `1. Low VRAM 8GB` **OFF** (keep `2. Pass-1 FirstBlockCache` **ON** for ~1.4x Pass-1 speedup!) |
| **Fast Scout (4–6 steps)** | Turn `3. Turbo 4-Step LoRA` **ON**, set Pass-1 `BasicScheduler` steps to `6` (swap LoRA file to `ref2v_lightx2v` in REF2VA mode), optionally turn `5. Pass-2 Repair` **OFF** |
| **Hero 1.5x / 2.0x Latent Upscale** | Inside `H3 Latent Auto Repair & Upscale`, set `spatial_scale` to `1.5` (960x576) or `2.0` (1280x768) |
| **Extreme Fast-Motion Timing** | Turn `6. Pass-2 H3DyRoPE (30-49)` **ON** (safe to combine with Pass-1 FirstBlockCache & Pass-2 Sol-Attn INT8 — zero conflicts!) |
| **Final 2x Export Polish** | Turn `7. RTX VSR (2x ULTRA)` **ON** (640x384 -> 1280x768, or 960x576 -> 1920x1152) |

---

## Verified Benchmark Notes (RTX 4060 8GB)
- **Calm clips auto-skip Pass 2 in 0.02s** (`H3 Repair Inject Schedule (Auto-Skip)` returns 0 steps when `auto_adaptive` keeps all blocks at 1x).
- **Pass-1 FirstBlockCache (`H3 Safe`)** runs on **Pass 1 ONLY** (~11% faster on 8GB, up to 1.42x on 16GB+, matching baseline quality) so it never collides with Pass-2 `H3DyRoPE`.
- **Pass-2 Sol-Attn INT8 (`min_tokens=12288`)** stays dense on short clips and automatically engages on long 1.5x/2.0x Pass-2 runs (~21% faster warm, sharper output `128.8` vs `115.1`, composes cleanly with KJ LowVRAM + `H3DyRoPE`).
- **One Decode Node (`H3 Exact VAE Decode & Recover`)** handles both Pass-2 ON (exact hold-map recovery + trailing chunk trim) and Pass-2 OFF (plain VAE decode) with zero rewiring.

[Shot 1] A martial artist performs a fast spinning high kick inside a sunlit wooden dojo.

detailed_description:
Locked-off medium-wide shot inside a traditional wooden dojo with warm afternoon light across the floorboards. A martial artist in a crisp white gi and black belt steps forward, pivots smoothly into a rapid spinning high kick, and lands in a balanced fighting stance. Keep limbs, gi folds, and facial features sharp and coherent throughout the turn.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet wooden dojo room tone, crisp fabric snap during the kick, and a firm barefoot landing on wood.
